briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI intensify AGI race as new frontier models trigger fresh safety alerts

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has accelerated with multiple frontier releases this month. Competition between US and Chinese labs remains fierce while regulatory pressure mounts globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4-preview while xAI released Grok-4. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 3 both demonstrated major capability jumps in agentic tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments while Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 100k GPU clusters. TSMC reports AI chip demand exceeding forecasts by 40%.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any lab achieve AGI-level performance before 2028 given current scaling trajectories?
